019package org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc;
020
021import static java.lang.String.format;
022import static java.lang.System.arraycopy;
023import static java.util.Objects.nonNull;
024import static javax.tools.Diagnostic.Kind.MANDATORY_WARNING;
025import static javax.tools.Diagnostic.Kind.WARNING;
026import static org.apiguardian.api.API.Status.STABLE;
027import static org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.OtherFileTagletBase.ProcessMode.DEFAULT;
028import static org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.ToolKit.EMPTY_STRING;
029import static org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.ToolKit.EMPTY_String_ARRAY;
030import static org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.ToolKit.isNotEmptyOrBlank;
031import static org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.ToolKit.splitString;
032
033import javax.lang.model.element.Element;
034import java.io.File;
035import java.io.FileReader;
036import java.io.IOException;
037import java.io.Reader;
038import java.util.List;
039
040import org.apiguardian.api.API;
041import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.JavadocError;
042import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.OtherFileTagletBase;
043import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.foundation.annotation.ClassVersion;
044import org.tquadrat.foundation.javadoc.internal.foundation.util.Template;
045import com.sun.source.doctree.DocTree;
046
047/**
048 *  <p>{@summary This taglet allows to include the contents of an external file
049 *  into the JavaDoc documentation.} This is particularly useful when the
050 *  contents of a resource file (like a DTD or an XML Schema) should be shown
051 *  in the documentation.</p>
052 *  <p>Usually, that file is stored somewhere on the
053 *  {@link #SOURCE_PATH SOURCE_PATH}; this means that a file is addressed
054 *  by its path name on the source tree. For example to include this file, the
055 *  path would be
056 *  {@code org/tquadrat/foundation/javadoc/IncludeTaglet.java}.</p>
057 *  <p>But additional roots can be provided through system properties, where
058 *  the name of the new root will be prefixed by
059 *  {@value #PROPERTY_INCLUDE_ROOT_PREFIX}, like
060 *  {@systemProperty org.tquadrat.foundation.include.root.resources}. To use this root,
061 *  prefix the path in the tag with {@code ${resources}}.</p>
062 *  <p>The file contents can be processed in some way before it will be
063 *  included; refer to
064 *  {@link ProcessMode}
065 *  for the details.</p>
066 *  <p>The use of this tag will look like this:</p>
067 *  <pre><code>&hellip; {&#64;include &lt;<i>filename</i>&gt;:&lt;<i>processMode</i>&gt;} &hellip;</code></pre>
068 *  <p>where the &lt;processMode&gt; can be omitted. If the given file does not
069 *  exist or is empty, nothing will be included, and no error message will be
070 *  issued.</p>
071 *  <p>Javadoc tags in the included files are not processed, even if the files
072 *  resides in a {@code doc-files} folder.</p>
073 *  <p><b>Notes:</b></p>
074 *  <ul>
075 *      <li>If Maven is used, and the include file is not placed at the
076 *      {@code java} path (but on the {@code resources} path, for example), it
077 *      is required to add the parameter <code>&lt;sourcepath&gt;</code> to the
078 *      configuration of the {@code maven-javadoc-plugin}, where the path of
079 *      the include file is added; otherwise, it will not be found.
080 *      Alternatively an external root can be used, as described above.</li>
081 *      <li>At default, Gradle adds only {@code *.java} files as sources for
082 *      the Javadoc task. To make other files available for the
083 *      {@code @include} tag, an external root should be used. This is
084 *      mandatory for files that are stored at the {@code resources} path.</li>
085 *      <li>In general, both Maven and Gradle may have funny ideas about the
086 *      source path, so the recommendation is to use an external root
087 *      always.</li>
088 *      <li>If the source of a class should be included, the path to the source
089 *      file is relative to the module directory, if one exists.</li>
090 *      <li>The {@code {@include}} tag is an inline tag; that means that the
091 *      contents of the included file will be seamlessly integrated into the
092 *      other text of the respective Javadoc comment.</li>
093 *  </ul>
094 *  <p>Alternatively, you can use the {@code @snippet} tag.</p>
095 *
096 *  @author Thomas Thrien - thomas.thrien@tquadrat.org
097 *  @version $Id: IncludeTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $
098 *  @since 0.0.5
099 */
100@ClassVersion( sourceVersion = "$Id: IncludeTaglet.java 1282 2026-09-08 23:52:53Z tquadrat $" )
101@API( status = STABLE, since = "0.0.5" )
102public final class IncludeTaglet extends OtherFileTagletBase
103{
104        /*-----------*\
105    ====** Constants **========================================================
106        \*-----------*/
107    /**
108     *  <p>{@summary The name of this taglet: {@value}.}</p>
109     */
110    public static final String TAGLET_NAME = "include";
111
112        /*--------------*\
113    ====** Constructors **=====================================================
114        \*--------------*/
115    /**
116     *  <p>{@summary Creates a new {@code IncludeTaglet} instance.}</p>
117     */
118    public IncludeTaglet()
119    {
120        super( TAGLET_NAME, true, Location.values() );
121    }   //  IncludeTaglet()
122
123        /*---------*\
124    ====** Methods **==========================================================
125        \*---------*/
126    /**
127     *  <p>{@summary Determines the name of an element for output.}</p>
128     *
129     *  @param  element The element.
130     *  @return The name of the element for output.
131     */
132    private final String determineElementName( final Element element )
133    {
134        final var retValue = switch( element.getKind() )
135            {
136                case PACKAGE -> element.toString().replace( '.', '/' ) + "/package-info.java";
137                case MODULE -> "module-info.java";
138                case ANNOTATION_TYPE, CLASS, ENUM, INTERFACE, RECORD -> element.toString().replace( '.', '/' ) + ".java";
139                case CONSTRUCTOR, ENUM_CONSTANT, FIELD, METHOD -> format( "%s::%s", determineElementName( element.getEnclosingElement() ), element );
140                default -> format( "Don't know yet how to get the output name for '%1$s' of kind '%2$s'", element, element.getKind() );
141            };
142
143        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
144        return retValue;
145    }   //  determineElementName()
146
147    /**
148     *  {@inheritDoc}
149     */
150    @Override
151    public final String toString( final List<? extends DocTree> tags, final Element element )
152    {
153        var retValue = EMPTY_STRING;
154
155        final var tag = tags.getFirst().toString().trim();
156        final var len = tag.length() - 1;
157        final var prefixLen = getName().length() + 3;
158        final var contents = tag.substring( prefixLen, len ).trim();
159
160        final var parts = splitString( contents, ':' );
161        final String fileName;
162        final ProcessMode processMode;
163        final String [] parameters;
164
165        switch( parts.length )
166        {
167            case 0 ->
168            {
169                //---* No argument for the tag *-------------------------------
170                fileName = EMPTY_STRING;
171                //noinspection AssignmentToNull
172                processMode = null;
173                //noinspection AssignmentToNull
174                parameters = null;
175            }
176            case 1 ->
177            {
178                //---* Just the file name *------------------------------------
179                fileName = new Template( parts[0].trim() ).replaceVariable( IncludeTaglet::rootPathRetriever );
180                processMode = DEFAULT;
181                parameters = EMPTY_String_ARRAY;
182            }
183            case 2 ->
184            {
185                //---* A file name and the process mode *----------------------
186                fileName = new Template( parts[0].trim() ).replaceVariable( IncludeTaglet::rootPathRetriever );
187                ProcessMode p;
188                try
189                {
190                    p = ProcessMode.valueOf( parts[1].trim() );
191                }
192                catch( final IllegalArgumentException _ )
193                {
194                    p = DEFAULT;
195                }
196                processMode = p;
197                parameters = EMPTY_String_ARRAY;
198            }
199            default ->
200            {
201                //---* A file name and the process mode plus some parameters *-
202                fileName = new Template( parts[0].trim() ).replaceVariable( IncludeTaglet::rootPathRetriever );
203                ProcessMode p;
204                try
205                {
206                    p = ProcessMode.valueOf( parts[1].trim() );
207                }
208                catch( final IllegalArgumentException _ )
209                {
210                    p = DEFAULT;
211                }
212                processMode = p;
213                final var length = parts.length - 2;
214                parameters = new String[length];
215                arraycopy( parts, 2, parameters, 0, length );
216            }
217        }
218
219        if( isNotEmptyOrBlank( fileName ) )
220        {
221            if( fileName.startsWith( "/" ) )
222            {
223                //---* An absolute path based on an external root *------------
224                final var file = new File( fileName );
225                if( !file.exists() )
226                {
227                    final var elementName = determineElementName( element );
228                    printf( WARNING,"Cannot locate the include file '%2$s' for '%1$s'%n", elementName, fileName );
229                }
230                //noinspection OverlyBroadCatchBlock
231                try( final Reader reader = new FileReader( file ) )
232                {
233                    //noinspection ConstantConditions
234                    retValue = processMode.processFile( fileName, reader, parameters );
235                }
236                catch( final IOException e )
237                {
238                    //---* Should never happen *-------------------------------
239                    final var elementName = determineElementName( element );
240                    printf( MANDATORY_WARNING,"Failed to include the file '%2$s' for '%1$s'%n", elementName, fileName );
241                }
242            }
243            else if( !fileName.startsWith( "$" ) )
244            {
245                //---* A relative path *---------------------------------------
246                try
247                {
248                    final var inputFile = getDocletEnvironment().getJavaFileManager().getFileForInput( SOURCE_PATH, EMPTY_STRING, fileName );
249                    if( nonNull( inputFile) )
250                    {
251                        //noinspection ConstantConditions
252                        retValue = processMode.processFile( inputFile, parameters );
253                    }
254                    else
255                    {
256                        final var elementName = determineElementName( element );
257                        printf( MANDATORY_WARNING, "Failed to include the file '%2$s' for '%1$s'%n", elementName, fileName );
258                    }
259                }
260                catch( final IOException e )
261                {
262                    throw new JavadocError( format( "Problems getting FileObject for '%s'", fileName ), e );
263                }
264            }
265            else
266            {
267                //---* Retrieval for the root path failed *--------------------
268                final var elementName = determineElementName( element );
269                printf( WARNING, "Failed to resolve include file '%2$s' for '%1$s'%n", elementName, fileName );
270            }
271        }
272
273        //---* Done *----------------------------------------------------------
274        return retValue;
275    }   //  toString()
276}
277//  class IncludeTaglet
278
279/*
280 *  End of File
281 */
